notes: Network resilience: the app now auto-heals on foreground resume and on Wi-Fi/VPN/Tailscale network changes, keeps the SSE replay cursor, uses a 90s stream timeout plus stale-socket watchdog, and shows network/stream/reconnect diagnostics. Voice: continuous dictation with live partials, auto-restart across pauses, tap mic to start/stop, and runtime microphone permission. New Tailscale troubleshooting guide. Plus usage CSV share, transcript file share, background-sync interval, connection diagnostics, image share, send-while-working queue, notifications/background sync, status filters, and live DeepSeek credit.
